note: 防御漏洞响应十段中英草稿，不含利用步骤。版本命中不等于可利用，补丁覆盖不等于安全证明；实际音频待验证，无估造时间轴。

series.title: 漏洞响应：版本命中、可利用暴露与补丁验证
series.premise: 供应商通报文档预览组件漏洞，镜像清单疑似命中受影响版本，运行配置与外部路径未知。
series.outcome: 确认六个实例中四个启用相关解析功能，外部上传路径可达；限制预览入口并保留安全替代下载。补丁灰度发现插件不兼容，更新插件后分批修复六个实例，验证运行版本与业务路径；历史日志空档及新变种风险保留复查。

accentTarget.basis: spoken audio duration excluding silence and narration

recycling.note: 未来回访候选，不计实际出现；不依赖其他同期草稿。

dialogues.title: 扫描命中还不是利用结论
dialogues.premise: 供应商通报刚收到，镜像扫描提示预览组件受影响。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出版本判断与运行风险判断的区别。

lines.en: Our image matches the affected version range. Runtime details aren't checked yet.
lines.zh: 镜像命中受影响版本范围，运行细节尚未检查。

lines.en: Does the advisory mention distribution backports? Package labels can mislead us.
lines.zh: 通报提到发行版回补吗？包版本标签可能误导。

lines.en: Okay, I'll take point on this. Just to confirm, no exploit claim, right?
lines.zh: 好，我来协调。确认一下，还不能宣称可利用，对吧？

lines.en: Right. Compare vendor guidance with running builds. Don't trust scanner names alone.
lines.zh: 对。把厂商指南和运行构建对比，别只信扫描名称。

lines.en: I'm on it for service inventory. Preview runs behind the gateway.
lines.zh: 我来整理服务清单，预览服务在网关后面运行。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis is parser exposure. Its enabled state remains unknown.
lines.zh: 当前假设是解析器暴露，但是否启用仍未知。

lines.en: Gateway placement isn't a safety guarantee. We need effective request paths.
lines.zh: 位于网关后不保证安全，需要实际请求路径。

lines.en: What's the ETA for running versions? About five minutes, maybe?
lines.zh: 运行版本预计多久确认？可能大约五分钟？

lines.en: Also check dormant instances and jobs. They may process documents later.
lines.zh: 也检查休眠实例和任务，它们之后可能处理文档。

lines.en: I'll include those owners too. No production probing beyond approved checks.
lines.zh: 我也会纳入那些负责人，不在生产做超出批准范围的探测。

dialogues.title: 清单漏掉了两个备用实例
dialogues.premise: 运行版本待核对，部署清单与服务发现数量不符。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出备用实例为什么仍需纳入漏洞响应。

lines.en: Asset reconciliation found six instances. The deployment sheet lists four only.
lines.zh: 资产核对发现六个实例，部署表只列了四个。

lines.en: Are the other two stale records? Confirm whether they're actually running.
lines.zh: 另外两个是过期记录吗？确认是否确实运行。

lines.en: They're warm standbys for batch previews. Both use the same component.
lines.zh: 是批量预览的温备实例，两者使用相同组件。

lines.en: Just to confirm, six candidates, right? That's our blast radius for review.
lines.zh: 确认一下，六个候选，对吧？这是本次评审范围。

lines.en: Candidates, not six exposed instances. Configuration could change the risk.
lines.zh: 是候选，不是六个暴露实例，配置会改变风险。

lines.en: Managed configuration disables parsing on standbys. I'll verify effective settings.
lines.zh: 受管配置在备用实例禁用了相关解析，我会核对生效设置。

lines.en: Check queued jobs too. A standby could activate during failover.
lines.zh: 也检查排队任务，备用实例可能在故障切换时启用。

lines.en: I'm on it. Maybe failover enables that feature automatically. I'll check.
lines.zh: 我来查，故障切换可能自动启用那个功能。

lines.en: Keep version evidence per instance. Inventory completeness needs independent confirmation.
lines.zh: 按实例保留版本证据，清单完整性需要独立确认。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, patch planning includes all six. Exposure assessment comes next.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，补丁计划包括全部六个，接下来判断暴露。

dialogues.title: 功能启用仍需路径证据
dialogues.premise: 六个实例均命中组件版本，四个线上实例启用相关解析，备用未启用。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别版本、功能条件和来源可控性。

lines.en: Exploit prerequisites include the affected parser. Four live instances enable it.
lines.zh: 可利用前提包括受影响解析器，四个线上实例启用了它。

lines.en: Then all four are exploitable? Or is input access still uncertain?
lines.zh: 那四个都能被利用？还是输入访问条件仍不确定？

lines.en: Input access matters. Check approved advisory conditions without recreating attacks here.
lines.zh: 输入访问条件很重要，按批准通报检查条件，不在这里复现攻击。

lines.en: Just to confirm, configuration matches one condition, right? Others remain open.
lines.zh: 确认一下，配置只满足一个条件，对吧？其他条件仍待核实。

lines.en: Our working hypothesis involves uploads. Internal imports also reach preview workers.
lines.zh: 当前假设涉及上传，内部导入也会进入预览工作进程。

lines.en: Then authentication alone doesn't rule that out. An authorized user may supply documents.
lines.zh: 那仅有认证不能排除风险，授权用户也能提供文档。

lines.en: I overstated the conclusion earlier. Maybe the upload route is filtered.
lines.zh: 我刚才下结论太早，上传路径可能有过滤。

lines.en: Verify filtering coverage and bypass routes. Don't assume one rule covers everything.
lines.zh: 验证过滤覆盖和其他路径，别假设一条规则覆盖所有情况。

lines.en: What's the ETA for route evidence? A broad rewrite, let's park that.
lines.zh: 路径证据预计多久？大规模重写先放一边。

lines.en: About three minutes for the map. I'll include import and failover paths.
lines.zh: 整理路径图大约三分钟，我会包括导入和故障切换路径。

dialogues.title: 网关后仍接收外部文档
dialogues.premise: 发现上传和内部导入均能到达线上解析功能，过滤覆盖待核实。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出确认可达的范围和不能从日志空白推断的结论。

lines.en: Reachable attack surface includes authenticated uploads. Those documents reach the affected parser.
lines.zh: 可达攻击面包括已认证上传，文档会到达受影响解析器。

lines.en: Does the filter remove the relevant input? Show effective coverage, not its name.
lines.zh: 过滤器去除了相关输入吗？看实际覆盖，不看名称。

lines.en: No, it checks size only. That's our blast radius for live preview.
lines.zh: 没有，只检查大小。这是线上预览的影响范围。

lines.en: Just to confirm, standbys are disabled now, right? Keep activation blocked.
lines.zh: 确认一下，备用当前禁用，对吧？继续阻止启用。

lines.en: Yes, but patch them too. Disabled today isn't permanently unreachable.
lines.zh: 对，但它们也要打补丁，今天禁用不代表永远不可达。

lines.en: No suspicious requests in available logs. Maybe older records are missing.
lines.zh: 现有日志未见可疑请求，但旧记录可能缺失。

lines.en: That isn't proof of no exploitation. The root cause is still open for gaps.
lines.zh: 这不证明没有被利用，日志空档根因仍未查明。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on queue age. Restricting preview will delay customers.
lines.zh: 我会关注队列等待时间，限制预览会让客户等待。

lines.en: Use the escalation path for suspicious activity. Preserve evidence before rotation.
lines.zh: 可疑活动走升级路径，日志轮转前保存证据。

lines.en: Okay, prepare a preview restriction. Downloads need a separately validated safe path.
lines.zh: 好，准备限制预览，下载需要单独验证的安全路径。

dialogues.title: 限制解析而非声称永久修复
dialogues.premise: 外部文档可达受影响功能，拟限制线上预览并继续安全下载。
dialogues.listeningTask: 理解补偿控制范围、业务代价与旁路检查。

lines.en: Disabling preview is a compensating control. It should buy us time for patching.
lines.zh: 禁用预览是补偿控制，应该能为补丁争取时间。

lines.en: What about internal imports? Blocking the public route alone leaves that path.
lines.zh: 内部导入呢？只阻止公共路径还会留下那条路径。

lines.en: We'll pause both parsing routes. Safe downloads don't invoke this component.
lines.zh: 暂停两条解析路径，安全下载不调用这个组件。

lines.en: Verify that separation with traces. Labels aren't enough to confirm isolation.
lines.zh: 用链路记录验证分离，标签不足以确认隔离。

lines.en: I'm on it. Just to confirm, queued documents stay unprocessed, right?
lines.zh: 我来做。确认一下，排队文档保持未处理，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, this temporary workaround costs preview availability. Maybe an hour initially.
lines.zh: 对，这个临时缓解牺牲预览可用性，初步可能一小时。

lines.en: Define a rollback trigger for service errors. Don't reopen vulnerable parsing blindly.
lines.zh: 设定服务错误的回退条件，别盲目恢复有漏洞的解析。

lines.en: Download errors mean stop and review. Preview remains blocked during troubleshooting.
lines.zh: 下载错误就停下评审，排查期间预览仍阻止。

lines.en: Both routes now reject parsing requests. Preserve the control's tested coverage.
lines.zh: 两条路径现在都拒绝解析请求，保存控制的已测覆盖。

lines.en: Okay, queues are held and downloads pass. I'll prepare an isolated patch candidate.
lines.zh: 好，队列已暂停且下载通过，我准备隔离的补丁候选。

dialogues.title: 灰度发现插件不兼容
dialogues.premise: 两条解析路径已阻止，隔离实例安装厂商补丁，准备测试业务。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出补丁安装成功与应用测试失败可同时成立。

lines.en: The patch canary runs the fixed build. The smoke test fails on thumbnails.
lines.zh: 补丁灰度运行修复构建，但缩略图冒烟测试失败。

lines.en: What's the error boundary? Startup, parsing, or the thumbnail plugin?
lines.zh: 错误发生在哪个边界？启动、解析还是缩略图插件？

lines.en: The plugin rejects the updated interface. Parsing itself completes with synthetic documents.
lines.zh: 插件拒绝新接口，合成文档的解析本身完成了。

lines.en: Just to confirm, no wider rollout, right? That's our rollback trigger.
lines.zh: 确认一下，不扩大部署，对吧？这触发回退条件。

lines.en: Pause expansion. Don't restore exposed production parsing to meet the schedule.
lines.zh: 暂停扩大，不要为了赶进度恢复暴露的生产解析。

lines.en: I'm on it for vendor guidance. Maybe a supported plugin update exists.
lines.zh: 我来查厂商指南，可能有受支持的插件更新。

lines.en: Keep the canary isolated during repair. Retest the complete workflow afterward.
lines.zh: 修复期间保持灰度隔离，之后重测完整流程。

lines.en: The vendor lists a compatible plugin. I'll test that combination first.
lines.zh: 厂商列出了兼容插件，我先测试那个组合。

lines.en: Record both build identifiers. A package installation message isn't runtime evidence.
lines.zh: 记录两个构建标识，安装成功消息不是运行证据。

lines.en: Okay, staged rollout stays paused. Update the business estimate after retesting.
lines.zh: 好，分阶段部署保持暂停，重测后更新业务时间预估。

dialogues.title: 插件更新后的完整路径
dialogues.premise: 隔离灰度安装受支持插件更新，待重新验证预览、下载和失败处理。
dialogues.listeningTask: 辨别业务兼容验证与漏洞条件验证。

lines.en: The compatibility check now passes. Previews and thumbnails match expected output.
lines.zh: 兼容检查现在通过，预览和缩略图输出符合预期。

lines.en: Did it cover invalid documents too? Error handling can change after updates.
lines.zh: 也覆盖无效文档了吗？更新后错误处理可能变化。

lines.en: Yes, approved malformed fixtures reject safely. No secrets appear in error logs.
lines.zh: 是，批准的格式异常测试样本被安全拒绝，错误日志没有秘密。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the smoke test covers downloads too, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，冒烟测试也覆盖下载，对吧？

lines.en: It does. But business success doesn't prove vulnerability remediation by itself.
lines.zh: 覆盖了，但业务成功本身不能证明漏洞修复。

lines.en: Agreed, vendor conditions need separate verification. Runtime build matches the advisory fix.
lines.zh: 同意，厂商条件需要单独验证，运行构建匹配通报修复。

lines.en: Let's keep it under observation. Record limits of the approved security checks.
lines.zh: 继续观察，记录批准安全检查的局限。

lines.en: I'll keep an eye on memory too. Maybe larger documents behave differently.
lines.zh: 我也关注内存，大文档可能表现不同。

lines.en: Use representative safe fixtures. Keep real customer documents out of test logs.
lines.zh: 用有代表性的安全样本，别让真实客户文档进入测试日志。

lines.en: Okay, what's the ETA for expansion? Wait for the observation checkpoint first.
lines.zh: 好，扩大部署预计什么时候？先等观察检查点。

dialogues.title: 六个实例都核实运行构建
dialogues.premise: 灰度观察通过，按批更新四个线上实例及两个备用，限制仍保持。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出全量覆盖的分母和解除限制的条件。

lines.en: Patch coverage is six of six. Every running build matches the fixed release.
lines.zh: 补丁覆盖六个中的全部六个，每个运行构建都匹配修复版本。

lines.en: Did managed configuration update the standby image? Restarts must not restore old builds.
lines.zh: 受管配置更新了备用镜像吗？重启不能恢复旧构建。

lines.en: Yes, both image references are pinned. The standby startup check passed too.
lines.zh: 是，两处镜像引用都锁定了，备用启动检查也通过。

lines.en: Just to confirm, staged rollout checks passed per batch, right?
lines.zh: 确认一下，每批的分阶段部署检查都通过，对吧？

lines.en: Yes, with inventory evidence. Coverage isn't a universal safety certificate.
lines.zh: 是，有清单证据，但覆盖不是普遍安全证明。

lines.en: I'm on it for controlled reopening. One route first, then internal imports.
lines.zh: 我负责受控重开，先一条路径，再内部导入。

lines.en: Recheck parser configuration before reopening. Keep the restriction available if errors recur.
lines.zh: 重开前再次检查解析配置，错误复发时能恢复限制。

lines.en: Maybe queues need rate control. I'll resume slowly to avoid overload.
lines.zh: 队列可能需要速率控制，我会缓慢恢复，避免过载。

lines.en: Record which restrictions were lifted. Audit logs still need historical review.
lines.zh: 记录解除了哪些限制，历史审计日志仍需检查。

lines.en: Okay, just to recap, patched paths reopen gradually. Incident review remains active.
lines.zh: 好，小结一下，修复路径逐步重开，事件评审继续。

dialogues.title: 修复已知条件，不承诺绝对安全
dialogues.premise: 受控重开后业务恢复，历史日志空档尚未补齐。
dialogues.listeningTask: 区分当前修复证据、历史未知和后续风险。

lines.en: Our update must mention residual exposure. Historical logging gaps remain unresolved.
lines.zh: 更新必须说明残余暴露，历史日志空档尚未解决。

lines.en: Separate current conditions from past activity. We've fixed the known version issue.
lines.zh: 把当前条件和历史活动分开，已修复已知版本问题。

lines.en: We're back to baseline on previews. Queue age is normal again.
lines.zh: 预览回到基线，队列等待时间也正常了。

lines.en: Report tested routes, not total security. New advisories may change our assessment.
lines.zh: 报告已测路径，不宣称完全安全，新通报可能改变判断。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the mitigation is holding, right? Reblocking remains available.
lines.zh: 确认一下，缓解持续有效，对吧？仍能重新阻止解析。

lines.en: Yes, maybe another checkpoint tomorrow. We'll circle back after log review.
lines.zh: 对，明天可能再检查一次，日志评审后再沟通。

lines.en: Use the escalation path for new indicators. Absence of alerts isn't proof.
lines.zh: 新线索走升级路径，没有告警不代表已经证明无事。

lines.en: Support gets a sanitized statement. I'll mention restored service and ongoing investigation.
lines.zh: 支持团队收到脱敏说明，我会写明服务恢复和持续调查。

lines.en: Good. Avoid component details in public updates. Keep evidence internally accessible.
lines.zh: 好。公共更新不放组件细节，内部保留可访问证据。

lines.en: I'll track advisory changes daily. The repaired inventory needs ongoing drift checks.
lines.zh: 我每天跟踪通报变化，修复后的清单仍需持续漂移检查。

dialogues.title: 把清单和证据缺口转成任务
dialogues.premise: 已知漏洞条件修复，业务恢复；复盘遗漏备用资产和日志覆盖不足。
dialogues.listeningTask: 听出响应改进的具体责任与验收标准。

lines.en: Set a response checkpoint for Friday. Each action item needs measurable evidence.
lines.zh: 设周五响应检查点，每项待办都要有可衡量证据。

lines.en: The missed standbys slowed us down. Asset reconciliation must include activation paths.
lines.zh: 遗漏备用拖慢了响应，资产核对必须包括启用路径。

lines.en: I'll own that inventory change. Maybe compare discovery and deployment daily.
lines.zh: 我负责清单改进，可能每天对比服务发现和部署记录。

lines.en: I'll own log completeness tests. They must flag collection gaps explicitly.
lines.zh: 我负责日志完整性测试，必须明确标记采集空档。

lines.en: Who's picking this up for plugin tests? I'll take those by Thursday.
lines.zh: 谁负责插件测试？我来做，周四前完成。

lines.en: Okay, include both safe documents and errors. No attack fixtures here, right?
lines.zh: 好，包括安全文档和错误路径，这里不用攻击样本，对吧？

lines.en: Correct. Specialist security validation follows an approved separate process, with isolation.
lines.zh: 对，专业安全验证走批准的独立流程，并保持隔离。

lines.en: Just to recap, patch completion isn't incident proof. Historical review stays open.
lines.zh: 小结一下，补丁完成不是事件无风险证明，历史调查保持开放。

lines.en: We'll close the loop with documented limits. Unknown activity must remain visible.
lines.zh: 我们用有明确局限的记录完成反馈，未知活动必须保持可见。

lines.en: Agreed, I'll link test evidence Friday. Then we review remaining risk together.
lines.zh: 同意，周五我附上测试证据，然后一起评审剩余风险。
